description: Fetch one Zinc order by its UUID and render a detail card: line items, retailer price breakdown, shipping destination, and shipment timeline.
name: get-order

title.description: What the shopper saw when buying through this connector; null otherwise.

error.description: Failure reason when status is order_failed

error_type.description: Worker's classification of the failure, e.g. max_price_exceeded

is_trial.description: max_price of 0 marks a trial run: the retailer validates the order and deliberately does not place it, charging nothing. That outcome is recorded as order_failed with error_type max_price_exceeded, and nothing went wrong — do not report it as a failure. A trial carrying any other error_type did fail, before the price ceiling was ever reached, and the error explains how. This flag is the one to read: a null max_price_cents is an unknown ceiling, never a trial.

item_count.description: Total units across all line items

item_urls.description: Retailer URL per line item. Zinc stores no product name, so this is the only identification of what was ordered — a title derived from the URL path was a guess and often wrong.

items.description: One per line item. title/image are what the shopper saw in the review card when the order was placed through this connector; null when the order came from elsewhere.

max_price_cents.description: Customer's price ceiling, in cents. Null means withheld, not zero: the public tracking view a guest reads does not carry it. A zero ceiling means something specific (see is_trial) that null does not.

retailer.description: Merchant inferred from the item URLs — Zinc stores no retailer field

retailer_logo.description: The retailer's mark, for rows with no product picture.

shipment_summary.description: One-line shipment state rolled up from the tracking rows

total_cents.description: What the retailer charged, in cents. Null when the order was never placed AND null on every list-orders row — the Zinc list endpoint omits it. Call get-order for the real total.

carrier.description: Carrier code, e.g. ups, usps, fedex

estimated_delivery_date.description: Carrier ETA as a destination-local YYYY-MM-DD date

status.description: pending, in_transit, or delivered; null before first scan

price_breakdown.description: Null until the retailer order is placed — unless prices_withheld is true, which means the amounts exist and this read cannot see them. All amounts in cents.

prices_withheld.description: True when the order was read without an account, from the public tracking view, which carries no money at all. The order may well have been charged in full: never report it as uncharged. False on a signed-in read, where a null breakdown does mean not charged yet.

title: Get a Zinc order
